answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 38 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in tide, verified in quartz, and signal names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Every extra alias adds 15 hours of verification and 15 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
